listen_addr.description: IP address to bind the 9P service to (e.g., '127.0.0.1' or '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces).

listen_port.description: TCP port for the 9P service. Default 564 is the standard 9P port.

root_path.description: Absolute path to the directory to be exported as the root filesystem.

auth_mode.description: Authentication method for clients. 'none' allows unauthenticated access, 'user' maps UIDs/GIDs, and 'tls' requires client TLS certificates.

tls_cert_path.description: Path to the server TLS certificate file (PEM format). Required when auth='tls'.

tls_key_path.description: Path to the server TLS private key file (PEM format). Required when auth='tls'.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections to accept.

verbose_logging.description: Enable detailed debug logging to stderr (includes request traces and internal state).

extra_filesystems.description: Additional filesystems to mount under the 9P namespace (beyond root). Each item defines a source path and a virtual mount point.

name.description: Human-readable name for this filesystem entry (used for comments).

path.description: Absolute path on the host to expose.

mount_point.description: Virtual path in the 9P namespace where this filesystem will appear (e.g., 'data', 'backup').

user_map.description: Mapping of remote usernames to local UIDs/GIDs for 'user' authentication. Each entry maps a username to 'uid:gid'.

username.description: Remote username as presented by the client.

uid.description: Local numeric user ID to map to.

gid.description: Local numeric group ID to map to.

server_name.description: Server name announced during 9P protocol negotiation. Helps clients identify the service.
